finding: The M5 candidate-generation wall cost is the single-core O(N^2 * D) exact VLAD top-k scan in candidate_pairs_vlad_scored_from_globals. Computing each image's independent, deterministic top-k (and each image's VLAD aggregate) with rayon leaves the exported candidate manifest byte-identical while cutting the 10k candidate wall by about 4x.

functions: candidate_pairs_vlad_scored_from_globals: per-image exact_topk_similar_images now runs under (0..n).into_par_iter(); the same BTreeMap<pair,max_score> admission follows.
candidate_pairs_vlad_scored: VLAD aggregation (vlad) now runs under features.par_iter(), preserving image order.
change.correctness_argument: exact_topk_similar_images is a deterministic pure function of (query, globals, topk); the previous mutual path already derived admission from completed neighbour sets. Indexed rayon collection preserves order, so the pair set, its tie order, and the max scores are unchanged.
change.not_included: No ANN/LSH behavior change. The existing approximate paths (--retrieval-backend ann with --ann-tables/--ann-bits/--ann-probes, and candidate_pairs_vlad_lsh_scored) remain the behavioral A/B and are not byte-identical by design.

measurements.environment: level=image-io release example unordered_sfm_demo; RAYON_NUM_THREADS controls threads

baseline_caveat: The frozen M5 tier-10000 candidates.txt was produced by an older policy: current main adds two manifest metadata lines (retrieval_fill_policy global-score-desc-v1, temporal_long_level_sampling dense-through-32;stride=offset/16) and differs from the frozen 10k manifest by roughly 10k of 70k pairs. The frozen candidate_wall_s=2989.03 is therefore NOT the current-code sequential baseline; the reported speedup is against the current code's own 1-thread run (5k measured, 10k from conserved CPU time).
